info.title: jeha
info.description:
REST API for jeha, a light automation daemon for Zigbee2MQTT.

Rooms are identified by their key under `[rooms]` in config.toml. Every response that changes something carries a human-readable `description`, so the API works as well for scripts as it does as a tool for an AI assistant.

Errors use HTTP status codes with a `{"error": "..."}` body.

When `api.token` is set, every endpoint except `/api/health`, `/api/openapi.json` and `/api/docs` requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

get.description:
Rooms come back sorted by display name, each with its light state,
occupancy and circadian status.

parameters.name: room_id
parameters.description: Room ID (the key under `[rooms]` in config.toml)

post.description:
With no brightness or colour temperature, only `state: ON` is sent: the
lights come back at their last state and move to the circadian target on
the next circadian update (unless circadian is paused or snoozed). Setting
either one is a manual override: circadian stops adjusting the room until
`override_ttl_mins` runs out or circadian is resumed.

requestBody.description: Optional; the body (and Content-Type) may be omitted
Optional; the body may be omitted

post.description: jeha stops adjusting the room's lights until circadian is resumed.

Clears any pause, snooze or manual override; the lights transition to the
circadian target on the next cycle.
Like pause, but circadian resumes by itself after `hours`.
Pauses circadian for the room. See `GET /api/scenes` for the available scenes.

get.description:
Scenes are stored in the room's Z2M group; create them in the Z2M frontend.
A room without a Z2M group returns an empty list.

200.description: Scenes stored in the room's Z2M group

400.description: Room has no Z2M group, or invalid body

post.summary: Switch night mode on or off.
post.description:
Night mode sets the room to its dim, warm night values and pauses
circadian; switching it off resumes circadian.

get.description: These can be applied to any room with `POST /api/rooms/{room_id}/scene`.

200.description: Circadian status per room, sorted by display name

put.summary: Set the house-wide wake and sleep times.
put.description:
Replaces `wake_time`/`sleep_time` from `circadian.defaults` for every room
that doesn't set its own in config.toml. Meant to be synced from another
system (e.g. Home Assistant) when the times vary from day to day. A field
left out goes back to the config value. Lights follow on the next circadian
update. The times are kept in memory only: after a restart jeha uses
config.toml again until they are set again.

delete.summary: Reset the house-wide schedule to config.toml.

post.summary: Switch night mode on or off for the whole house.
post.description:
Same as `POST /api/rooms/{room_id}/night-mode` for every room, so an
automation doesn't need updating when rooms are added. A room that fails
doesn't stop the others; it's listed under `failed`.

200.description: Night mode switched in all or some rooms

get.description: MQTT and Zigbee2MQTT connectivity, uptime and device counts.

Always answers 200 while the daemon is running, and never requires a
token, so it can back a container health check.

ActionResponse.description:
Result of a state-changing room action. Fields beyond `status`, `room` and
`description` are only present for the actions they belong to.

z2m_scene.description: Name of the recalled Z2M scene (`z2m-scenes/recall`).

scene_id.description: ID of the recalled Z2M scene (`z2m-scenes/recall`).

CircadianState.description:
- `active`: lights follow the circadian curve
- `manual_override`: brightness or colour was set by hand; see `remaining_mins`
- `snoozed`: paused for a fixed time; see `remaining_secs`
- `paused`: paused until resumed
- `disabled`: `circadian_enabled = false` for the room

CircadianStatus.description: Whether jeha is currently steering a room's lights, and for how long not.

description.description: Human-readable summary, suitable for showing to a user or an LLM.

remaining_mins.description: Minutes until a manual override expires (`manual_override` only).

remaining.description: Snooze time left, formatted like `1h 20m` (`snoozed` only).

remaining_secs.description: Snooze time left in seconds (`snoozed` only).

ErrorResponse.description: Error body returned with every 4xx/5xx response.

error.example: Room 'attic' not found. Available rooms: kitchen, office

status.description: `ok` when every room switched, `partial` when some failed.

failed.description: Rooms that failed, with the reason.

LightOffRequest.description: Turn a room's lights off. The body is optional.

LightOnRequest.description:
Turn a room's lights on. All fields are optional. Without `brightness` or
`color_temp_k`, only `state: ON` is sent and circadian control of the room
is restored; the lights move to the circadian target on the next circadian
update unless circadian is paused or snoozed.

brightness.description: Brightness, 1-254. Setting this (or `color_temp_k`) is a manual override.

color_temp_k.description: Colour temperature in Kelvin. Setting this (or `brightness`) is a manual override.

override_ttl_mins.description:
Minutes until a manual override expires and circadian takes over again.
Without it, the override lasts until circadian is resumed.

RecallZ2mSceneRequest.description: Recall a scene stored in the room's Zigbee2MQTT group.

override_ttl_mins.description: Minutes until circadian takes over again.

RoomCircadian.description: Circadian state of one room, as listed by `GET /api/circadian`.

motion_timeout_secs.description: Seconds without motion before the lights turn off. Null without a motion sensor.

remotes.description: IEEE addresses of the remotes bound to this room.

color_temp_mired.description: Last known colour temperature in mired.

rooms_with_own_schedule.description:
Rooms that set their own `wake_time` or `sleep_time` in config.toml.
The house-wide schedule doesn't change those times for them.

SetHouseNightModeRequest.description: Switch night mode on or off for every room.

SetNightModeRequest.description: Switch night mode on or off.

SetSceneRequest.description: Apply one of jeha's built-in scenes (see `GET /api/scenes`).

override_ttl_mins.description:
Minutes until circadian takes over again. Without it, the scene stays
until circadian is resumed.

SetScheduleRequest.description:
Set the house-wide wake and sleep times. A field that is left out falls
back to `circadian.defaults` in config.toml.

SnoozeRequest.description: Pause circadian adjustments for a fixed time.

hours.description: Hours to snooze for, greater than 0 and at most 24.

z2m_online.description: Whether the Zigbee2MQTT bridge reports itself online.

Z2mScene.description: A scene stored in a Zigbee2MQTT group.

z2m_group.description: The room's Z2M group. Absent when the room has none.
